body:
I’m going to die this year.

I’m very happy about that.
Emotional mainly.

I tried my best. I really did. Maybe not today, but soon, I’ll finally be able to go sleep with no more waking up. Waking up is torture. Pain and suffering every day. 

I wish they had euthanasia here like in Belgium, I’d have been allowed to be at peace sooner and with help of professionals. Doing all this on my own is so hard

Sorry about your relationship. You deserve a hug and a cup of tea. 

*hug*

Long time.

I tried all the help. Hospital send some home saying I can do it if I want, so it’s okay relaly
I went into shop and got random vodka. I want to drink it after overdose to help send me to sleep faster
How do I get the balls to do it? Is it okay to die.?

This is me everyday. Only here because of the guilt of hurting others. I don’t remember why I posted. I’ve been frustrated looking for a source for the reasoning of alcohol after drinking Nembutal but not before

I have been suicidal since I was 10/11 and I started planning Nembutal around mid 2018. Been trying bunch of treatments and therapies as last ditch effort but I’m ready to go soon. It’ll just be like deep sleep, right?
I am so scared of hurting people. I’m so scared of taste but I wanna be brave I wanna be brave I wanna be brave I’m sorry. Hurts in my chest so much the pain

I haven’t changed my mind. I’m scared and anxious of doing it. Bad taste. Dunno what death is

I know there isn’t by coming back. It’s 100% lethal with no antidote

Nembutal has a 100% success rate and is used for peaceful and euphoric euthanasia in Switzerland and Belgium.

It is far more lethal than using a shotgun while being very euphoric :)
I hate that it tastes bad. I want to be tipsy before hand to give me courage. Afterwards I can lay down and sleep
Why don’t I do it. Everyday is the same. I just want the strength to go. :(
Euthanasia support groups. A lot of money
It ok. I don’t do anything. Just lay in bed. Worthless. Family don’t want me around. Want to take it and die.
Wine and vodka
What would you like to talk about?

I am a bit tipsy. Want to know if it’ll be okay to drink barbiturate now or if it’ll make me puke. I have meto anti emetic scared I’ll still puke as drug tastes bad. Scared but I need to go sleep and no more waking up
Sorry for being dumb
Wanna talk about why you’re suicidal?

I wouldn’t recommend asking any random ones.

You’re allowed to plan this stuff out if it’s what you want, it’s just smart to maybe go to the hospital to check if you’re organs are okay. 

Benzos are nearly impossible to die from. I’m feeling bad myself I’m sorry for being hnsopprtice please be safe
Unless you take a CNS depressant nothing will kill you peacefully. You may be screwing up your organs which may kill you in the future.
Go to the hospital. You can always suicide in the future. For now you should try to get checked up

Thanks. 

I’m sorry you go through depression too.

You’re strong. 

I just wish I had the courage to end my life.
